heading: Product FAQ & Details
subtitle: Visual inspection paired with detailed product specifications.

questions.question: What are the exact packed dimensions when folded for travel?
questions.answer: Folds down flat to 35cm x 25cm x 4cm, fitting comfortably inside standard carry-on luggage sleeves.

questions.question: Does the fabric stretch under active movement?
questions.answer: Incorporates 2% elastane woven into the virgin wool warp for 4-way micro-stretch mobility without sagging.

questions.question: How many interior utility pockets are integrated?
questions.answer: Includes 2 RFID-shielded zip pockets, a dedicated pen sleeve, and a passport-sized interior security pouch.
